notes.title: Save Games are Here!
notes.content: [p]A much-requested feature, [b]saving your game[/b], is now available! This feature took a while to come about because the game was not initially written with saving sessions in mind, and so a good chunk of refactoring was required. That's all out of the way now, and here we are![/p][p][/p][h1]Profiles[/h1][p]On the title screen, to the left, you'll see a new button for Profiles. When you first start the game, a new profile will be created for your Steam username. You can add, rename and manage extra profiles for other players you may share the game with.[/p][p][/p][p]Each profile will store its own save games and local score file, so each player can resume their previous games and track their personal best scores.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]If you delete a profile, then all of its data including saves and local scores will be deleted as well.[/i] [/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Game Saves[/h1][p]When you go to select a game mode (classic, survival, or arcade) if a save game file is detected you will be prompted if you would like to continue your save or start a new one. [b]If you start a new game, your previous save will be overwritten for that game mode.[/b] Each game mode tracks its own save, so you can jump between them as you like but you can only have one active game per mode.[/p][p][/p][h1]Steam Cloud[/h1][p]Steam Cloud has been enabled for the game and all of your profile data should be sync'd automatically when you start and exit the game. This will let you quit out of a game on your PC and pick it back up on your Steam Deck, and vice versa.[/p][p][/p][h1]Achievement Balance[/h1][p]I've seen the chatter around achievements, and I hear you. The fruit matching achievements were way too grindy and looking at global achievement percentages the top survival achievements were just not being hit. [/p][p][/p][p][b]So, the match number have been nerfed dramatically, and Survival 15 and Survival 20 have been removed completely.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The hardest achievements like matching two watermelons and Pren's achievement are staying. They are difficult, and not many people have them, but the ones that do have earned them, so I won't be taking those away. I see them as true achievements, so congrats to those who have hit those goals.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Achievement Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Cherries 1000 -> 1000 (no change)[/p][p align="start"]Strawberries 1000 -> 500 (50% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Grapes 1000 -> 250 (75% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Mandarins 750 -> 125 (83% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Oranges 500 -> 50 (90% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Apples 350 -> 35 (90% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Lemons 250 -> 20 (92% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Peaches 150 -> 15 (90% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Pineapples 100 -> 10 (90% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Honeydews 50 -> 5 (90% reduction)[/p][p align="start"]Watermelons 1 -> 1 (no change)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I hope these changes find you well and you continue to enjoy the game in your own way. Thank you for your continued support![/p]

notes.title: New Skin and Achievements Balance
notes.content:
Happy October, Fruit Salad players!

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
This update brings a balance pass for the fruit-matching achievements. The numbers were a bit too high for the later fruits and have been reduced dramatically. You should get the achievements upon starting the game if you meet the new thresholds.

The following achievements have been tuned:
[list]
[*] Mandarin Madness! - 1000 - 750
[*] Orange Overload! - 1000 -> 500
[*] Apple Apocalypse! - 1000 -> 350
[*] Lemon Lunacy! - 1000 -> 250
[*] Peach Pandemonium! - 750 -> 150
[*] Pineapple Problems! - 500 -> 100
[*] Honeydew Hoopla! - 250 -> 50
[/list]

[h3]New Skin[/h3]
It's time for billiards! ...sort of.

The new Drop Pockets skin (featuring: Marble, D20, Golf ball, Cue ball, 8 ball, Pinball, Crystal ball, Magic 8 ball, Basketball, Dodgeball, and Bowling ball) is now available to everyone.

This new skin is inspired by Drop Pockets, the billiards roguelike developed by Fruit Salad's very own artist, SkeletalGadget!

Drop Pockets has strategic, physics-based billiards gameplay where you go up against Pool Sharks who don't play by the rules. If you're interested, then you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3005620/Drop_Pockets/]wishlist it here[/url]!

notes.title: Fruit Salad Update 2024-02-16
notes.content:
[b]Build 1.0.02162024[/b]

This update includes a fix for the leaderboards, a QOL change for players who like to play in windowed mode, and two new skins!

[h3]Skins[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Skin - Tropical (Featuring: Blueberry, Raspberry, Kiwi, Starfruit, Lime, Pomegranate, Grapefruit, Dragon Fruit, Coconut, Durian, Jackfruit)
[*] New Skin - Pren's Reward (granted when earning the Pren's Challenge achievement)
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Window size and position are now saved when not in fullscreen mode.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a clipping issue with the friend's leaderboard.
[/list]

notes.title: Trading Cards are here!
notes.content:
Happy 2024 everyone!

We hope everyone had a wonderful holiday season and enjoyed their time as much as we did.

The new year brings new things to Fruit Salad in the form of our very own trading cards, backgrounds, and emoticons now available for you to earn by playing! If you've been playing you should already have some cards in your inventory, go check them out.

Enjoy, have fun and keep dropping those fruit!

notes.title: Fruit Salad Update 2023-12-18
notes.content:
[b]Build 1.0.12182023[/b]

We hope everyone is having a great holiday season so far! This update brings some small bug fixes and includes a couple of new features in that you can now select the audio and display device from the settings screen!

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added audio device selection to settings.
[*] Added display device selection to settings.
[*] The game will now pause automatically when the window loses focus.
[*] Increased the visible score size on the leaderboards.
[*] The elapsed game time now always shows on the finish screen to show how long you played.
[/list]
[h3]Arcade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where a power-up fruit would show its default face when matched.
[/list]

notes.title: 'Tis the season for Christmas updates!
notes.content:
This update brings a new skin system to Fruit Salad which we plan to leverage for FREE skin updates in the future, and the first of these is available right now. The Christmas skin!

You can find this new feature under Settings, just click the Skins button!

[b]Build 1.0.12012023[/b]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new skins system.
[*] Added the Christmas skin.
[/list]

notes.title: Fruit Salad Update 2023-11-25
notes.content:
[b]Build 1.0.11252023[/b]

This update includes bug fixes for some outstanding issues impacting users such as memory usage and a problematic texture issue on integrated GPUs such as laptops or NUC devices. These should (hopefully) be resolved now. 

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered texture memory requirements.
[*] Fixed texture issue affecting users on integrated GPUs.
[*] Removed mouse screen confinement.
[*] Game music now does a quicker rotation through the available songs.
[*] Added new setting to disable screen transitions.
[*] Adjusted bounciness of fruits.
[*] Increased responsiveness of mouse aiming.
[*] Increased keyboard and controller aim speed.
[/list]
[h3]Arcade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where fruit would not fall until jostled.
[*] Added popup text showing points gained from a bomb or rotten match.
[/list]
[h3]Daily Salad[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Daily Salad remaining time display.
[*] Fixed Daily Salad not resetting when restarting a game.
[/list]
